subject: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report and audit-window clarification
messages:
From: Julie Bennett <julie.bennett@acme-analytics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Requesting SOC 2 Type II report + audit window clarification

Hi Vanessa,

We're running a security review for an upcoming procurement decision and I need the latest SOC 2 Type II report for Redwood Inference. Specifically:

- The formal report (PDF) covering the most recent Type II period
- Any bridge letter or management assertion if the test period does not fully align with our required coverage (we need clarity on whether the controls cover Jan 1, 2026 - Mar 31, 2027)
- A summary of scope (in-scope services, exclusions) and whether Redwood hosts customer data in shared or dedicated infrastructure for hosted API customers

Can you also confirm options for secure evidence transfer and whether you can provide a short one-line reply templates our procurement team can use internally? Our deadlines are tight — procurement would like materials by Apr 8.

Thanks,

Julie Bennett
Security Manager, Acme Analytics
julie.bennett@acme-analytics.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0199

P.S. We have a short vendor questionnaire that may follow once we review the report.
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julie Bennett <julie.bennett@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requesting SOC 2 Type II report + audit window clarification

Hi Julie — thanks for the note and the timeline. We can get that to you. Quick summary and what I'm attaching: 

Attachments (attached to this email):
- SOC2_Report_2026_TypeII.pdf (full report, redacted where necessary)
- Bridge_Letter_Sample.pdf (signed bridge letter template we use when customers need coverage beyond the test period)
- Evidence_Transfer_Options.txt (secure transfer methods and retention notes)

What we recommend you look for (short checklist):
- Report period / testing window (top-level on page 2)
- In-scope services & exclusions (appendix)
- Complementary user controls note (if you are integrating via API)
- Any vendor-hosting notes (hosted API = multi-tenant unless customer has Dedicated/Private)

If the report period does not align with your required window, the bridge letter explains coverage and whether control operation changed materially after the test period. A short excerpt is included in the Bridge_Letter_Sample.pdf.

Secure transfer options (in Evidence_Transfer_Options.txt):
- Pre-signed S3 (time-limited) — preferred for large bundles
- Secure SFTP with access accounts
- Vendor portal (one-time access link)

For procurement: below are two short template replies your team can paste into an RFP or internal note. I included a slightly longer summary as well in one_line_replies.txt. If you want us to upload report to an S3 presigned link, tell us the preferred expiry (48h/7d) and whether your team needs IP address allowlist.

One quick clarification: our most recent Type II testing window is Jan 1, 2025 through Dec 31, 2026. If you need coverage into 2027 we can provide a bridge letter that describes controls through a management assertion and any interim changes. Karthik will add the exact wording we typically use.

Let me know your preferred transfer method and whether procurement needs the full exhibit set (logs, control samples) or only the auditor's report + bridge letter. We'll prioritize for Apr 8.

Regards,

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Customer Security Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference — Trust & Security
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julie Bennett <julie.bennett@acme-analytics.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requesting SOC 2 Type II report + audit window clarification

Hi Julie — quick follow-up with exact audit-period language and two short templates you can reuse.

Audit period we tested: 2025-01-01 to 2026-12-31 (covers controls operating for that 24-month period).
If you need statement language for procurement that references coverage through Mar 31, 2027, we provide a signed bridge letter that:
- Affirms no material changes to controls since the end of the test period
- Notes any compensating controls or interim updates (if applicable)

One-line procurement template (paste-ready):
"Redwood Inference provided a SOC 2 Type II report covering 01-Jan-2025 through 31-Dec-2026. A bridge letter is available upon request to extend the asserted coverage to our required timeframe."

Short confirmation for SOWs (longer):
"The attached SOC 2 Type II report and accompanying bridge letter (if requested) describe the control environment and test procedures performed by our independent auditor. Please advise if you require additional control evidence (log samples, change control artifacts) and the preferred secure transfer method."

I've also attached one_line_replies.txt with two more variants and a suggested DocuSign link flow for the bridge letter. Vanessas' team can sign the bridge letter; we can deliver via presigned S3 or a vendor portal.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
Director, Trust & Security — Redwood Inference
From: Julie Bennett <julie.bennett@acme-analytics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requesting SOC 2 Type II report + audit window clarification

Vanessa / Karthik — thanks, this is great and timely. Please: 

1) Generate a presigned S3 link (7d expiry) and send the upload URL to security@acme-analytics.com.
2) Include the bridge letter signed PDF and the one-line reply samples.
3) Quick question: do you have guidance on redacting customer-specific PII from control samples, or do you prefer to deliver auditor-redacted artifacts?

If we get the bundle today we can get procurement to review before Apr 8. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Julie

Julie Bennett
Security Manager, Acme Analytics
